description: Proudly introducing this absolute showstopper to the market! With over 1,800 square feet this bi-level floorplan flows generously into the 2 Living spaces, 3 spacious Bedrooms and 2 newly renovated Bathrooms! No detail has been overlooked, complete with new and upgraded flooring throughout, new fixtures, fresh paint, designer accent tile, new appliances, and new water heater. Retreat outside to your fenced-in living space and enjoy gorgeous views with the mature landscaping, a brand new Trex deck and extended paver patio, garden area and shed for extra storage! After a long day, enjoy a hot soak in your brand-new spa! The oversized 2 car garage and double driveway is perfect for overflow parking. This beauty is move-in ready with all the upgrades, both inside and outside of the home, having been completed for you. Located in a quaint neighborhood with great schools, just a short walk to Oakhurst Park and the trails to Standley Lake and fast access to Wadsworth and Hwy 36.
